sourceQuote: Now, these two affiliated hospitals have gone into the leadership in China in the fields of multi-slice spiral CT (MSCT) coronary angiography, catheter ablation treatment for atrial fibrillation, integrated traditional Chinese and western medicine in acute abdominal diseases, etc.
targetQuote: 如今，这两所附属医院在多层螺旋CT（MSCT）冠状动脉造影、房颤导管消融治疗、急性腹部疾病中西医结合等领域已进入全国领先行列。
